item.title: Christmas Past: An Advent Book for Seniors: A true Christmas story for every day of Advent.
item.description: Twenty-four true stories from Christmases gone by, one for each day from December 1 to 24: how a department store invented Rudolph, and what three astronauts read from the Moon on Christmas Eve, 1968. Each day adds a five-question quiz and a page to remember and share. The Christmas Past: An Advent Book for Seniors from Plainfield Press, a paperback on Amazon. Free sample pages to print at the link. christmas trivia for seniors, christmas stories for seniors, advent activities for seniors.
